album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 3

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Ak in Nowruz-e Saba. The line peaks at D5 (560.1 Hz) at 0:16.6. It closes on C4, not the tonic (D4 → Fk4 → Eb4 → D4 → C4 → C4).
